lessons.claim: For ONE particle in an analytic external potential, HOOMD's md.force.Custom costs a Python callback every step and delivers ~3000 steps/s, so a 140-run sweep projected to 8 hours. The same dynamics carried as M independent replicas in an (M,3) numpy array costs the same per STEP regardless of M: 200 replicas x 300 tau_w in 190 s, about 1000x the throughput. Validated against the HOOMD runs at four parameter values before use (agreement 1.12, 0.82, -0.21, 0.25 sigma). The sharper error bar then exposed a +5 percent dt bias at dt=1e-4 that the noisier HOOMD runs could not resolve -- speed bought accuracy, not just time.
